description_en: Queries the rule evaluation results for resources in a specified account group
description_zh: 从资源维度查询指定账号组内规则对资源的评估结果
kebab_example: aliyun config list-aggregate-resource-evaluation-results --resource-type ACS::RAM::User --resource-id 236426606353960000 --risk-level 1 --sort-by LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp-Asc --compliance-type NON_COMPLIANT --next-token IWBjqMYSy0is7zSMGu160000 --max-results 10 --biz-region global --aggregator-id ca-7f00626622af00410000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAggregateResourceEvaluationResults

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

For more information about how to obtain the resource type, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。

关于如何获取资源类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID.

For more information about how to obtain the resource ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。

关于如何获取资源类型ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the compliance package. Valid values:

1: high

2: medium

3: low
parameters.help_zh:
合规包风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en: The sorting method. By default, this parameter is not specified. The supported value is `LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp-Asc`. This value sorts resources based on the time when they first became non-compliant, in ascending order. You must set the `ComplianceType` parameter to `NON_COMPLIANT`
parameters.help_zh: 默认不传值。当前支持：`LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp-Asc`，越早开始出现不合规的资源则排序越靠前。应配合设置`ComplianceType`字段为`NON_COMPLIANT`使用
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The resource is compliant.

NON_COMPLIANT: The resource is non-compliant.

NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule does not apply to the resource.

INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data is available for the resource.

IGNORED: The evaluation result is ignored
parameters.help_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据。
IGNORED：已忽略
parameters.name: compliance_type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the response is truncated, you can use this token to initiate another request to retrieve the remaining records
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the resource resides. For example, `global` indicates Global and `cn-hangzhou` indicates China (Hangzhou).

For more information about how to obtain the region ID of a resource, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源归属的地域ID，例如：`global`表示全球，`cn-hangzhou`表示华东1（杭州）。

关于如何获取资源归属的地域ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

EvaluationResults.description_en: The evaluation results of the resources

EvaluationResultList.description_en: A list of resource evaluation results

Annotation.description_en: The supplementary information about the non-compliant resource
Annotation.description_zh: 不合规资源的补充信息

ComplianceType.description_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The resource is compliant.

NON_COMPLIANT: The resource is non-compliant.

NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule does not apply to the resource.

INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data is available for the resource.

IGNORED: The evaluation result is ignored
ComplianceType.description_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：

NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。

IGNORED：已忽略

ConfigRuleInvokedTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the rule was invoked to evaluate the resource. Unit: milliseconds
ConfigRuleInvokedTimestamp.description_zh: 调用规则评估资源的时间戳。单位：毫秒

EvaluationId.description_en: The unique ID of the evaluation result

EvaluationResultIdentifier.description_en: The identifier of the resource evaluation result

EvaluationResultQualifier.description_en: The resource information in the evaluation result
EvaluationResultQualifier.description_zh: 资源评估结果中的资源信息

IgnoreDate.description_en:
The date on which the ignored evaluation result is automatically resumed.

If this parameter is empty, the result is not automatically resumed. You must manually resume the result
IgnoreDate.description_zh:
已忽略评估结果的自动恢复日期。

为空表示不会自动恢复，需要您手动恢复

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the resource resides

ResourceOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resource belongs
ResourceOwnerId.description_zh: 资源归属的阿里云账号ID

OrderingTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp displayed on the timeline. Unit: milliseconds

规则触发机制。取值：
ConfigurationItemChangeNotification：配置变更。
ScheduledNotification：周期执行

LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the resource last became non-compliant
LastNonCompliantRecordTimestamp.description_zh: 最近一次不合规的起始时间

RemediationEnabled.description_en:

是否启用修正设置。取值：

ResultRecordedTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the evaluation result was recorded. Unit: milliseconds

RiskLevel.description_en:

1: high
